launcher.$description: The ecosystem launcher — the chooser an operator lands on, and the only screen that shows the whole ecosystem at once (AD-D-038). Structure only: the tiles carry no product hue, because identity here is a drawn glyph and a name. A colour per product would mint accent hues with no ramp, no contrast gate and no token behind them, beside a status ladder that already owns five meanings — and it would fail twice over in the operational themes.

padding-compact.$description: Padding once the launcher is in a panel rather than on a page. Container-queried, not viewport-queried: it has to hold up in a side panel at desktop width.

padding.$description: The plate's extent is icon + 2x this (24 + 16 = 40px) rather than a stated square, so the plate cannot drift out of step with the glyph it holds — and so no token here names a `-size` the touch floor would raise to 44px around a decorative plate. The hit area is the whole tile.

radius.$description: Steps DOWN from the tile's radius: a shape inset by a full padding step cannot carry the parent's curve without looking swollen.

padding-y.$description: The chip is sized by its padding and line-height rather than by a height token. It is a static readout, not a control — a height token would be raised to the 44px touch floor around a word.
